GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
